name: Transformer
instruction: Can you create a 3D model of an electrical transformer? It should have a cylindrical core with windings around it. Include the input and output terminals on opposite sides.

Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The core, input and output terminals are proportionate to the entire transformer.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The cylindrical core is the central component.
The windings are evenly distributed around the core.
The input and output terminals are positioned correctly on opposite sides.
Object distance and contact: The windings do not overlap with the terminals.
There is adequate space between the terminals and the core.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
The cylindrical core and windings are correctly modeled.
